localChanges: While you're at peace with a civilisation, moving a land unit onto an improved square one of its cities is working asks "Cancel action" or "Break treaty", as in Civ1. Cancel keeps the unit where it is but still uses up the move, and Break treaty makes the move and ends the peace. Pillaging such a square asks the same question. Diplomats, Caravans, ships and aircraft cross freely (closes #287).

Under the Republic or Democracy the Senate won't let you break a treaty: Break treaty, a sneak attack or capture, or a Diplomat stealing or inciting a revolt at peace is "Overruled by the Senate. Action canceled." (#133).
Your units on GoTo, and computer players, go round a treaty partner's worked land instead of crossing it.
